description: Header file defining a FIFO buffer API for dynamic memory management, including creation, cloning, destruction, resetting, pushing, pulling, and direct memory access functions. Used for temporary stream buffering between components or threads.

classes.name: icFifoBuff
classes.description: Opaque structure representing the FIFO buffer state and data.

methods.name: fifoBuffCreate
methods.description: Creates a new FIFO buffer with specified initial size or default.

methods.name: fifoBuffClone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an existing FIFO buffer.

methods.name: fifoBuffDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the FIFO buffer and frees associated memory.

methods.name: fifoBuffClear
methods.description: Resets the buffer content without releasing memory.

methods.name: fifoBuffGetPushAvailable
methods.description: Returns available space for pushing data.

methods.name: fifoBuffPush
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer, expanding if necessary.

methods.name: fifoBuffPushByte
methods.description: Appends a single byte to the buffer.

methods.name: fifoBuffPushPointer
methods.description: Provides direct access to buffer memory for efficient appending.

methods.name: fifoBuffAfterPushPointer
methods.description: Updates internal structure after direct memory push.

methods.name: fifoBuffGetPullAvailable
methods.description: Returns total data available for pulling.

methods.name: fifoBuffPull
methods.description: Extracts data from the buffer into provided memory.

methods.name: fifoBuffPullPointer
methods.description: Provides direct access to buffer data for reading.

methods.name: fifoBuffAfterPullPointer
methods.description: Updates internal structure after direct memory read.
